learned.record:
On 12 April 2019 the Security Council adopted the United States draft S/2019/311 as resolution 2466 by 13 votes to none, with the Dominican Republic and Russia abstaining. Acting under Chapter VII, it extended MINUJUSTH for a final six months until 15 October. It requested the Secretary-General to plan a successor United Nations presence including a special political mission.

France: France said the Chapter VII language gave MINUJUSTH the means to finish its assigned tasks and implement the Secretary-General's recommendations.
Russian Federation: Russia objected to applying Chapter VII across the entire MINUJUSTH mandate, including human rights monitoring, and questioned treating that issue as a threat to international peace.
Dominican Republic: The Dominican Republic urged consideration of timing and conditions when planning further United Nations work after the mission.
